adversaries.name: Apprentice Assassin
adversaries.description: A young trainee eager to prove themselves.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Assassin is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Assassin, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Apprentice Assassins within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Archer Squadron
adversaries.description: A group of trained archers bearing massive bows.

features.name: Horde
features.description: When the Squadron has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d6+3 physical damage instead.

features.name: Focused Volley
features.description: Spend a Fear to target a point within Far range. Make an attack with advantage against all targets within Close range of that point. Targets the Squadron succeeds against take 1d10+4 physical damage.

features.name: Suppressing Fire
features.description: Mark a Stress to target a point within Far range. Until the next roll with Fear, a creature who moves within Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, they take 2d6+3 physical damage. On a success, they take half damage.

adversaries.name: Assassin Poisoner
adversaries.description: A cunning scoundrel skilled in both poisons and ambushing.

features.name: Grindletooth Venom
features.description: Targets who mark HP from the Assassin's attacks are Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Out of Nowhere
features.description: The Assassin has advantage on attacks if they are Hidden.

features.name: Fumigation
features.description: Drop a smoke bomb that fills the air within Close range with smoke, Dizzying all targets in this area. Dizzied targets have disadvantage on their next action roll, then clear the condition.

adversaries.name: Banshee
adversaries.description: A corrupted fey spirit that haunts the night in the form of a willowy specter wearing a luminous gossamer gown.

features.name: Specter
features.description: The Banshee has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Terrifying
features.description: When the Banshee makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Scare Tactic
features.description: Up to three times per scene, spend a Fear to have the Banshee teleport up to Very Far range and scare a PC within Melee range. The PC marks 1d4 Stress. If this causes them to mark HP, they also lose a Hope.

features.name: Wail of Despair
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Banshee unleash a mournful scream of pain and anguish. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d12+1 magic damage. Targets who fail take double damage and are knocked back to Close range.

adversaries.name: Basilisk
adversaries.description: A six-legged monitor lizard that has the head of a vulture, a spiked backbone, and a petrifying gaze.

features.name: Petrify
features.description: Spend a Fear to force a PC within Far range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a success, the target marks a Stress. On a failure, the target becomes Stiff. If the target is already StijJ, they become Petrified. While StijJ, the PC must mark a Stress each time they act until they take a rest or the Basilisk is defeated. While Petrified, the PC can't act. The Petrified condition can be cleared only by applying Basilisk saliva to the target.

features.name: CRONCH!
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Basilisk chomp down on a Petrified PC within Melee range. The target must make a death move.

adversaries.name: Battle Box
adversaries.description: A cube-shaped construct with a different rune on each of their six sides.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Box can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Randomized Tactics
features.description: Mark a Stress and roll a d6. The Box uses the corresponding move: 1. Mana Beam (attack Far range, 2d10+2 magic damage). 2. Fire Jets (attack Close range, 2d8 physical damage). 3. Trample (attack Close range PCs, 1d6+5 physical damage and Vulnerable). 4. Shocking Gas (Finesse Reaction Roll or mark 3 Stress). 5. Stunning Clap (Strength Reaction Roll or Vulnerable). 6. Psionic Whine (Presence Reaction Roll or 2d4+9 direct magic damage).

features.name: Overcharge
features.description: Before rolling damage for the Box's attack, you can mark a Stress to add a d6 to the damage roll. Additionally, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Death Quake
features.description: When the Box marks their last HP, the magic powering them ruptures in an explosion of force. All targets within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 2d8+1 magic damage.

adversaries.name: Berserker Alpha
adversaries.description: A veteran commander who quaffs magic elixirs to change into a beast and lead their packmates on a hunt.

features.name: Pack Fury
features.description: The Alpha gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

features.name: Bark at the Moon
features.description: Once per scene, spend a Fear to have each ally within Close range of the Alpha clear a HP and a Stress.

features.name: Berserker Rage
features.description: The first time in a scene the Alpha marks their last Stress, they gain a +6 bonus to damage rolls.

adversaries.name: Berserker Initiate
adversaries.description: A raging warrior who imbibes ritualistic concoctions to enhance their form with aspects of a predatory beast.

features.name: Pack Fury
features.description: The Initiate gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

features.name: Berserker Rage
features.description: The first time in a scene the Initiate marks their last Stress, they gain a +4 bonus to damage rolls.

adversaries.name: Centaur Warden
adversaries.description: A half-human, half-horse guardian who patrols the borders of idyllic lands uncorrupted by the touch of civilization.
motives_tactics: use mobility and distance to drive off intruders

features.name: Flanking Maneuver
features.description: When the Warden makes a standard attack against a target within Melee range of one or more of the Warden's allies, the Warden gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

features.name: Eye of the Sage
features.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack. The Warden has advantage on the attack roll and critically succeeds on a roll of 19-20.

features.name: Trample
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Warden gallop up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in their path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d6+2 physical damage. Targets who fail take double damage and must

features.name: Quick Volley
features.description: When the Warden makes a standard attack, you can mark any number of Stress to target an equal number of additional creatures within range.

adversaries.name: Chaos Skull
adversaries.description: A floating humanoid skull animated by scintillating magic.

features.name: Levitation
features.description: The Skull levitates several feet off the ground and can't be Restrained.

features.name: Wards
features.description: The Skull is resistant to magic damage.

features.name: Magic Burst
features.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Skull succeeds against take 2d6+4 magic damage.

features.name: Siphon Magic
features.description: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a PC with a Spellcast trait within Very Close range. On a success, the target marks 1d4 Stress and the Skull clears that many Stress. Additionally, on a success, the Skull can immediately be spotlighted again.

adversaries.name: Chicken-Foot Hut
adversaries.description: A tall wooden shack that moves around on giant chicken legs.

features.name: Fast
features.description: The Hut can move up to Far range when spotlighted.

features.name: Double Strike
features.description: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Pin
features.description: When the Hut makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target. The Hut drags the Restrained target when it moves.

adversaries.name: Conscript
adversaries.description: A poorly trained civilian pressed into war.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Conscript is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Conscript, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Conscripts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Courtesan
adversaries.description: An accomplished manipulator and master of the social arts.

features.name: Searing Glance
features.description: When a PC within Close range makes a Presence Roll, you can mark a Stress to cast a gaze toward the aftermath. On the target's failure, they must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until the scene ends or they succeed on a social action against the Courtesan. On the target's success, they must mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Cult Adept
adversaries.description: An experienced mage wielding shadow and fear.

features.name: Enervating Blast
features.description: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against a target within range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Shroud of the Fallen
features.description: Mark a Stress to wrap an ally within Close range in a shroud of Protection until the Adept marks their last HP. While Protected, the target has resistance to all damage.

features.name: Shadow Shackles
features.description: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point are Restrained in smoky chains until they break free with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll. A target Restrained by this feature must spend a Hope to make an action roll.

features.name: Fear Is Fuel
features.description: Twice per scene, when a PC rolls a failure with Fear, clear a Stress.

adversaries.name: Cult Fang
adversaries.description: A professional killer-turned-cultist.

features.name: Shadow's Embrace
features.description: The Fang can climb and walk on vertical surfaces. Mark a Stress to move from one shadow to another within Far range.

features.name: Pick Off the Straggler
features.description: Mark a Stress to cause a target within Melee range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target must mark 2 Stress and is teleported with the Fang to a shadow within Far range, making them temporarily Vulnerable. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Cult Initiate
adversaries.description: A low-ranking cultist in simple robes, eager to gain power.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Initiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Initiate, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cult Initiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Demonic Hound Pack
adversaries.description: Unnatural hounds lit from within by hellfire.

features.name: Horde
features.description: When the Pack has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Dreadhowl
features.description: Mark a Stress to make all targets within Very Close range lose a Hope. If a target is not able to lose a Hope, they must instead mark 2 Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Pack makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Dire Pangolati
adversaries.description: A carriage-sized pangolin-coati hybrid covered in armor plating. It has a bladed tail it uses to fling razor-sharp scales.

features.name: Armor Eater
features.description: When the Pangolati makes a successful attack against a PC, that PC must mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity of the damage.

features.name: Blade Spin
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Pangolati quickly spin in a circle. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d8 physical damage.

features.name: Blade Fling
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Pangolati flick its tail and fling a razor-edged armor plate. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, the attack deals 2d6+10 physical damage.

features.name: Keratin Scales
features.description: When the Pangolati would mark HP from an attack, you can mark a Stress to reduce the number of HP it marks by 1.

adversaries.name: Doppelhound
adversaries.description: A vicious magical canid that has glowing eyes and two barbed, whiplike tails. It confuses enemies by conjuring an illusory duplicate of itself.

features.name: Blink Beast
features.description: When combat begins, place a duplicate within Close range of the Doppelhound. The Doppelhound occupies both its place and its duplicate's. The duplicate can move when the Doppelhound is spotlighted, and the Doppelhound can target enemies with attacks as if it were in its duplicate's place. When the Doppelhound or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a d6. On an even result, they target the Doppelhound. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. If an attack succeeds against the Doppelhound, the duplicate is dispelled until you spend a Fear to conjure it again.

features.name: Double Strike
features.description: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

adversaries.name: Dragon Knight
adversaries.description: A knight clad in dragonplate armor and a helmet in the shape of a dragon's head.

features.name: High Ground
features.description: The Knight gains advantage on attacks made against targets below them.

features.name: Leaping Strike
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Knight leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make a standard attack against them. On a success, the attack deals an extra 1d12 damage, and the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the

features.name: Comeback
features.description: When the Knight fails a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the attack with advantage.

adversaries.name: Electric Eels
adversaries.description: A swarm of eels that encircle and electrocute.

features.name: Horde
features.description: When the Eels have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Paralyzing Shock
features.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. You gain a Fear for each target that marks HP.

adversaries.name: Elephant
adversaries.description: A huge pachyderm that has large ears and a prehensile trunk.

features.name: Trample
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Elephant charge up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in its path must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d10+3 physical damage.

features.name: Toss
features.description: When the Elephant makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to have it toss the target to another location within Close range and deal an extra 1d12 damage.

adversaries.name: Elite Soldier
adversaries.description: An armored squire or experienced commoner looking to advance.

features.name: Reinforce
features.description: Mark a Stress to move into Melee range of an ally and make a standard attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage and the ally can clear a Stress.

features.name: Vassal's Loyalty
features.description: When the Soldier is within Very Close range of a knight or other noble who would take damage, you can mark a Stress to move into Melee range of them and take the damage instead.

adversaries.name: Entombed Cat Beast
adversaries.description: A large undead humanoid skeleton with a panther's skull for a head.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Cat Beast can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Bloody Strike
features.description: A PC who marks 3 or more HP from an attack made by the Cat Beast must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Screeching Caterwaul
features.description: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range of the Cat Beast to make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail become Rattled until they roll with Hope When the Cat Beast makes a successful attack against a Rattled PC, roll damage twice and take the better result, then clear the Rattled condition from the target.

features.name: I Alone
features.description: When the Cat Beast first appears, you can choose to have them absorb the essence of their allies. Immediately defeat any number of allies on the battlefield, and gain a Fear for each ally defeated this way.

features.name: Vicious Reprisal
features.description: When the Cat Beast takes damage from an attack made by a PC within Very Close range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against that PC.

adversaries.name: Entombed Elite Guard
adversaries.description: An elite undead soldier buried with their empress to defend the tomb from theft and desecration.

features.name: Battle Formation
features.description: The Guard gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each ally within Very Close range.

features.name: Javelin
features.description: Make an attack against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.

adversaries.name: Entombed Empress
adversaries.description: The undead ruler of a forgotten realm. She's been given blasphemous funeral rites to prevent her soul from moving on.

features.name: Empty Husk
features.description: The Empress has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Missing Organs
features.description: The Empress's internal organs have been removed and placed into six crystal containers hidden throughout her tomb. Each time the PCs find and destroy one, the Empress marks a HP.

features.name: Grasping Chains
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Empress target a creature within Close range and try to telekinetically bind them with her funeral chains. Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the Empress pulls the target into Melee range, deals 2d8 physical damage, and temporarily Restrains them.

features.name: Deathless Obedience
features.description: Up to three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to spotlight any number of allies within Close range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine

features.name: Accursed Caress
features.description: When the Empress makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to activate a Doom Countdown (1d6+1) for that PC. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the PC marks all HP and makes a death move. If the Empress is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

features.name: Final Transformation (Phose Change)
features.description: When the Empress marks her last HP, replace her with the Entombed Cat Beast and immediately spotlight them.

adversaries.name: Entombed Necropriest
adversaries.description: A necromancer charged with preserving the empress's life beyond death.

features.name: Invigorate
features.description: Mark a Stress to choose up to three allies within Far range. Each one gains advantage on their next attack roll.

features.name: Last Grasp
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a PC within Far range. Skeletal hands burst out of the ground at the PC's feet and Restrain them until the PC breaks free with a successful Strength Roll. When a target Restrained in this way spends Hope, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Chill Touch
features.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and must mark 1d4 Stress. If the target marks their last Stress from this attack, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Entombed Skin Beetles
adversaries.description: Flesh-eating beetles that burrow beneath the skin.

features.name: Horde
features.description: When the Beetles have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Beetles make a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Omophagous
features.description: Mark a HP to have 5 Beetles burrow under the skin of a PC within Melee range, forcing them to mark a Stress and Infecting them. While Infected, the target takes 6 direct physical damage every time they roll with Fear. This condition is cleared when the PC clears a HP or a Stress.

adversaries.name: Entombed Stonemason
adversaries.description: An unfortunate undead laborer chosen by lottery to wall up their empress's tomb from the inside.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Stonemason is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Stonemason, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range their attack

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Entombed Stonemasons within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: The Work Never Ends
features.description: When the Stonemason is defeated by an attack that deals physical damage, you can spend a Fear to clear the Stonemason's HP and Stress.

adversaries.name: Failed Experiment
adversaries.description: A magical necromantic experiment gone wrong, leaving them warped and ungainly.

features.name: Warped Fortitude
features.description: The Experiment is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.description: When a target the Experiment attacks has other adversaries within Very Close range, the Experiment deals double damage.

features.name: Lurching Lunge
features.description: Mark a Stress to spotlight the Experiment as an additional GM move instead of spending Fear.

adversaries.name: Flock of Feather Fiends
adversaries.description: A flock of undead crow corpses, eyes aglow with necroplasmic light.

features.name: Horde
features.description: When the Flock has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d6+1 magic damage instead.

features.name: Maddening Cacophony
features.description: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Very Close range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must spend a Hope or become Vulnerable until they deal damage to the Flock or the Flock is defeated.

adversaries.name: Fowlbear
adversaries.description: A grizzly bear with a feathery hide and the head of a giant goose.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Fowlbear can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Double Strike
features.description: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Dread Honk
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Fowlbear unleash a terrifying, ear-splitting goose honk. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark a Stress, move away from the Fowlbear to Far range, and become Vulnerable until the Fowlbear deals damage to them. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or move away from the Fowlbear to Far range.

adversaries.name: Fungispunj Sporeling
adversaries.description: A halfling-sized mushroom creature that defends itself from attackers with tiny puffs of neurotoxic spores.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Sporeling is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sporeling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Form Up
features.description: Spend a Fear to combine three Sporelings within a Close area and replace them with a Fungispunj Sporophore.

adversaries.name: Fungispunj Sporophore
adversaries.description: A giant mushroom creature that can command the dead.

features.name: Neurotoxic Spore Cloud
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Sporophore spray a cloud of spores on all targets within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Agility Reaction Roll or become Poisoned until they spend a Hope to clear the condition. While Poisoned, a target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Reanimator
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Sporophore spray a corpse within Very Close range with a cloud of psychic spores. The corpse clears all HP and Stress, then reanimates under the psychic control of the Sporophore. When the Sporophore is spotlighted, you can also spotlight all corpses it controls.

features.name: Colony
features.description: Mark any number of Stress to have the Sporophore summon an equal number of Fungispunj Sporelings

features.name: Mind Meld
features.description: All Fungispunj can telepathically communicate with one another. When the Sporophore would be forced to mark Stress from an attack, it can cause Fungispunj allies in the scene to mark that Stress in its place, distributed among allies as it chooses.

adversaries.name: Gargoyle
adversaries.description: A magically animated statue resembling a terrifying beast or demon.

features.name: Unliving
features.description: The Gargoyle has resistance to magic damage.

features.name: Swooping Strike
features.description: Choose a point within Far range. The Gargoyle moves to that point and makes a standard attack against one target along its path.

features.name: Petrifying Slash
features.description: When the Gargoyle deals damage, the target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Vulnerable. If the target is already Vulnerable, they become Restrained. If the target is already Vulnerable and Restrained, they must make a death move. The PC can spend a Hope per condition to clear it.

adversaries.name: Giant Beastmaster
adversaries.description: A leather-clad warrior bearing a whip and massive bow.

features.name: Two as One
features.description: When the Beastmaster is spotlighted, you can also spotlight a Tier 1 animal adversary currently under their control.

features.name: Pinning Strike
features.description: Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, you can mark a Stress to pin them to a nearby surface. The pinned target is Restrained until they break free with a successful Finesse or Strength Roll.

features.name: Deadly Companion
features.description: Twice per scene, summon a Bear, Dire Wolf, or similar Tier 1 animal adversary under the Beastmaster's control. The adversary appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

adversaries.name: Giant Brawler
adversaries.description: An especially muscular giant wielding a warhammer larger than a human.

features.name: Battering Ram
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Brawler charge at an inanimate object within Close range they could feasibly smash (such as a wall, cart, or market stand) and destroy it. All targets within Very Close range of the object must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d4+3 physical damage from the shrapnel.

features.name: Bloody Reprisal
features.description: When the Brawler marks 2 or more HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can make a standard attack against the attacker. On a success, the Brawler deals 2d6+15 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Brawler makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Giant Eagle
adversaries.description: A giant bird of prey with blood-stained talons.

features.name: Flight
features.description: While flying, the Eagle gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Deadly Dive
features.description: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage and knock the target over, making them Vulnerable until they next act.

features.name: Take Off
features.description: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d4+3 physical damage and the target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or become temporarily Restrained within the Eagle's massive talons. If the target is Restrained, the Eagle immediately lifts into the air to Very Far range above the battlefield while holding them.

features.name: Deadly Drop
features.description: While flying, the Eagle can drop a Restrained target they are holding. When dropped, the target is no longer Restrained but starts falling. If their fall isn't prevented during the PCs' next action, the target takes 2d20 physical damage when they land.

adversaries.name: Giant Octopus
adversaries.description: A monstrous, aquatic mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Octopus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Armed and Dangerous
features.description: When the Octopus first appears, place a d8 on this stat block with the 8 value facing up. When the Octopus makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can add the die's value to the damage dealt. After you add its value to a roll, decrease the die's value by 1.

features.name: Grapple
features.description: When the Octopus succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to have the Octopus Grapple the target. While Grappled, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll.

features.name: Crush
features.description: Mark a Stress to deal 3d8 direct physical damage to a target Grappled by the Octopus.

adversaries.name: Giant Recruit
adversaries.description: A giant fighter wearing borrowed armor.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Recruit is defeated when they take any damage. For every 7 damage a PC deals to the Recruit, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Giant Recruits within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Gobstalker
adversaries.description: A fleshy, floating ball of teeth that has numerous eyes and a bundle of questing mouth tentacles that shoot magic beams.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Gobstalker can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Anti-Mystica-Holitosis
features.description: The Gobstalker's rancid breath creates an invisible, magic-negating miasma. An attack, an ability, or a spell that deals magic damage or creates a magic effect fails automatically if used within Close range of the Gobstalker.

features.name: Tentacle Rays
features.description: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, roll a d8 for a random beam attack or spend a Fear to choose instead: 1. Beguile. The Gobstalker Beguiles the target. While Beguiled, the target sees the Gobstalker as a friend and can't attack it. Additionally, when a PC rolls with Fear, a Beguiled PC must mark a Stress or attack a target chosen by the Gobstalker. A Beguiled PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) to clear the condition. 2. Corrode. The target takes 2d8 magic damage and must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't, double the damage. 3. Doom. The target must mark all HP, but they can spend any number of Hope to reduce the number of HP marked this way by an equal amount. 4. Hypnosis. The target falls into a Deep Trance and can't act except to try to wake up. This condition lasts until the target takes damage or wakes up with a successful Presence Roll (16). 5. Paralyze. The target freezes in place, becoming Vulnerable and Restrained until they mark 2 Stress. 6. Sear. The target takes 2d8 direct magic damage. 7. Scare. The target is Scared. While Scared, the target can't take actions other than fleeing the battle or trying to shake off their terror. Additionally, the target must mark a Stress whenever you spend a Fear. The target can clear the condition with a successful Presence Roll (16). 8. Slow. The target becomes Vulnerable and must mark a Stress to move until they spend 2 Hope.

features.name: Leech Lick
features.description: On a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to clear a number of Stress equal to the number of HP the target marked.

adversaries.name: Gorgon
adversaries.description: A snake-headed, scaled humanoid with a gilded bow, enraged that their peace has been disturbed.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Gorgon can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Sunsear Arrows
features.description: When the Gorgon makes a successful standard attack, the target Glows until the end of the scene and can't become Hidden. Attack rolls made against a Glowing target have advantage.

features.name: Crown of Serpents
features.description: Make an attack roll against a target within Melee range using the Gorgon's protective snakes. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 2d10+4 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Petrifying Gaze
features.description: When the Gorgon takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can spend a Fear to force the attacker to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they begin to turn to stone, marking a HP and starting a Petrification Countdown (4). This countdown ticks down when the Gorgon is attacked. When it triggers, the target must make a death move. If the Gorgon is defeated, all petrification countdowns end.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Gorgon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Guahalan Alebrujo
adversaries.description: A huge, colorful, chimeric beast formed from many animals.

features.name: The Beast Unleashed
features.description: The Alebrujo gains a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

features.name: Guahalan Sacrifice
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Alebrujo devour a Minion within Very Close range, then clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Howl of the Guahala
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Alebrujo emit a howl. Each PC within Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or become temporarily Panicked. While Panicked, a PC must mark a Stress when they take the spotlight.

features.name: Rip & Tear
features.description: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, you can mark a Stress to make another standard attack against an additional target within range. You can continue marking Stress to make additional attacks until the Alebrujo fails an attack roll.

features.name: Brutal Spectacle
features.description: When the Alebrujo deals Severe damage, you can spend a Fear to force all targets within Close range to mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Guahalan Fang Lord
adversaries.description: A shapeshifting warlord who leads a group of warriors into battle.

features.name: Pack Alpha
features.description: Pool. When the Fang Lord makes a successful attack, add a token to the Guahalan Pool. When a Guahalan ally within Close range makes an attack, you can spend a token from the Guahalan Pool to give them advantage on the roll.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Fang Lord adopt a bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Call of the Guahala
features.description: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight all Guahalan Shifters within Close range. Each one makes a standard attack against a target within range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Feral Form (Phase Change)
features.description: When the Fang Lord marks their last HP, replace them with the Guahalan Alebrujo and immediately spotlight them.

adversaries.name: Guahalan Shifter
adversaries.description: A shapeshifting masked warrior who has animalistic features.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Shifter adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Pack Attack
features.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack. On a success, the attack gains a bonus to damage equal to the number of other Shifters within Very Close range of the target.

adversaries.name: Guahalan Spirit Beast
adversaries.description: A brightly colored spirit in the shape of an animal.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Spirit Beast is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Spirit Beast, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Ethereal Form
features.description: The Spirit Beast has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Beast Bomb
features.description: When the Spirit Beast is defeated, it explodes in white flame and deals 5 magic damage to creatures within Melee range.

adversaries.name: Guahalan Spirit Singer
adversaries.description: A shapeshifting summoner who has animalistic features.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Spirit Singer adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Beast-Caller
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Spirit Singer summon 2d4 Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and immediately spotlight one.

features.name: Rage of Spirits
features.description: Mark a Stress to spotlight any number of Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and have each one move into Melee range with the nearest PC and make a standard attack. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Spiritual Sacrifice
features.description: When the Spirit Singer would take damage while within Very Close range of a Guahalan Spirit Beast, you can spend a Fear to sacrifice the Spirit Beast and negate the damage.

adversaries.name: Hill Titan
adversaries.description: A goliath clad in animal skins and surrounded by a swarm of insects.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Gullible
features.description: PCs have advantage on action rolls to trick or emotionally manipulate the Titan.

features.name: Bug Swarm
features.description: PCs are Vulnerable while within Very Close range.

features.name: Mighty Swing
features.description: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range.

adversaries.name: Hive Walker
adversaries.description: A corpse filled with and puppeted by a colony of carrion-eating bees.

features.name: Blood Honey
features.description: The Walker disgorges thick crimson honey at all targets between it and a point within Close range. Each target in that line must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d8 magic damage and become temporarily Restrained as the honey hardens on them.

features.name: Bee-Ruption
features.description: When the Walker marks HP, vengeful bees erupt from its body to protect it. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 1d8 direct physical damage for each HP the Hive Walker has marked. Restrained targets automatically fail the reaction roll.

adversaries.name: Jack-o’-Lantern
adversaries.description: A floating pumpkin or other gourd that has a face carved into it. The soul trapped within it emits an eerie glow.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Jack-o'-Lantern is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Jack-o- Lantern, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Jack-o'-Lanterns within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Spine-Chilling Cackle
features.description: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Fear, you can mark a Stress to gain an additional Fear.

adversaries.name: Juvenile Flickerfly
adversaries.description: A horse-sized insect with iridescent scales and crystalline wings moving faster than the eye can see.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Flickerfly can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Peerless Accuracy
features.description: Before the Flickerfly makes an attack, roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the target's Evasion is halved against this attack.

features.name: Mind Dance
features.description: Mark a Stress to create a magically dazzling display that grapples the minds of nearby foes. All targets within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear and the Flickerfly learns one of the target's fears.

features.name: Hallucinatory Breath
features.description: When the Flickerfly takes damage for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, the Flickerfly breathes hallucinatory gas on all targets in front of them up to Far range. Targets must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be tormented by fearful hallucinations. Targets whose fears are known to the Flickerfly have disadvantage on this roll. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

adversaries.name: Knight of the Realm
adversaries.description: A decorated soldier with heavy armor and a powerful steed.

features.name: Chevalier
features.description: While the Knight is on a mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When they take Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount and lose this benefit until they're next spotlighted.

features.name: Heavily Armored
features.description: When the Knight takes physical damage, reduce it by 3.

features.name: Cavalry Charge
features.description: If the Knight is mounted, move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: For the Realm!
features.description: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4+1 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

adversaries.name: Landshark
adversaries.description: A quadrupedal shark that swims through the ground.

features.name: Burrowing
features.description: The Landshark can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Landshark moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Landshark has resistance to all damage but can't attack.

features.name: Thick-Skinned
features.description: When the Landshark would be forced to mark any number of HP, you can mark an equal number of

features.name: Rending Chomp
features.description: When the Landshark makes a successful attack against a PC within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the

adversaries.name: Landshark Behemoth
adversaries.description: A landshark that's lived long enough to become a large burrowing monstrosity with steely hide and razor-sharp teeth.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Behemoth can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Deep Diver
features.description: The Behemoth can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Behemoth moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Behemoth is immune to damage but can't attack.

features.name: Steel-Skinned
features.description: All damage dealt to the Behemoth is reduced by one threshold.

features.name: Forceful Eruption
features.description: The Behemoth erupts from the ground, forcing each PC within Very Close range to succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, becoming Vulnerable until they make an action roll. For each PC made Vulnerable in this way, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Masked Thief
adversaries.description: A cunning thief with acrobatic skill and a flair for the dramatic.

features.name: Quick Hands
features.description: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage and the Thief steals one item or consumable from the target's inventory.

features.name: Escape Plan
features.description: Mark a Stress to reveal a snare trap set anywhere on the battlefield by the Thief. All targets within Very Close range of the trap must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (13) or be pulled off their feet and suspended upside down. A target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Finesse or Strength Roll (13).

adversaries.name: Master Assassin
adversaries.description: A seasoned killer with a threatening voice and a deadly blade.

features.name: Won't See It Coming
features.description: The Assassin deals direct damage while they're Hidden.

features.name: Strike as One
features.description: Mark a Stress to spotlight a number of other Assassins equal to the Assassin's unmarked Stress.

features.name: The Subtle Blade
features.description: When the Assassin successfully makes a standard attack against a Vulnerable target, you can spend a Fear to deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Assassin makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Merchant Baron
adversaries.description: An accomplished merchant with a large operation under their command.

features.name: Everyone Has a Price
features.description: Spend a Fear to offer a target a dangerous bargain for something they want or need. If used on a PC, they must make a Presence Reaction Roll (17). On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or take the deal.

features.name: The Best Muscle Money Can Buy
features.description: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon 1d4+1 Tier 1 adversaries, who appear at Close range, to enforce the Baron's will.

adversaries.name: Minotaur Wrecker
adversaries.description: A massive bull-headed firbolg with a quick temper.

features.name: Ramp Up
features.description: You must spend a Fear to spotlight the Minotaur. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

features.name: Charging Bull
features.description: Mark a Stress to charge through a group within Close range and make an attack against all targets in the Minotaur's path. Targets the Minotaur succeeds against take 2d6+8 physical damage and are knocked back to Very Far range. If a target is knocked into a solid object or another creature, they take an extra 1d6 damage (combine the damage).

features.name: Gore
features.description: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range, moving the Minotaur into Melee range of them. On a success, deal 2d8 direct physical damage.

adversaries.name: Mortal Hunter
adversaries.description: An undead figure wearing a heavy leather coat, with searching eyes and a casually cruel demeanor.

features.name: Terrifying
features.description: When the Hunter makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Deathlock
features.description: Spend a Fear to curse a target within Very Close range with a necrotic Deathlock until the end of the scene. Attacks made by the Hunter against a Deathlocked target deal direct damage. The Hunter can only maintain one Deathlock at a time.

features.name: Inevitable Death
features.description: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

features.name: Rampage
features.description: When the Hunter is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, move the Hunter in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against all targets in their path. Targets the Hunter succeeds against take 2d8+2 physical damage.

adversaries.name: Ravenous Mockery
adversaries.description: A shapeshifting predator that assumes the appearance of inanimate objects to lure unwary prey into its threat range.

features.name: Tongue Attack
features.description: Mark a Stress to attack a creature within Close range. On a success, the target is pulled into Melee range with the Mockery and Restrained until they escape with a successful Strength Roll, and you can spend a Fear to activate the Mockery's Devour feature against the target.

features.name: Devour
features.description: Attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the Mockery Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Mockery is spotlighted. The Mockery disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

features.name: Never Just One
features.description: Spend a Fear to reveal that another object on the battlefield has been a Ravenous Mockery the whole time, then immediately spotlight it.

adversaries.name: Royal Advisor
adversaries.description: A high-ranking courtier with the ear of the local nobility.

features.name: Devastating Retort
features.description: A PC who rolls less than 17 on an action roll targeting the Advisor must mark a Stress.

features.name: Bend Ears
features.description: Mark a Stress to influence an NPC within Melee range with whispered words. That target's opinion on one matter shifts toward the Advisor's preference unless it is in direct opposition to the target's motives.

features.name: Scapegoat
features.description: Spend a Fear to convince a crowd or notable individual that one person or group is responsible for some problem facing the target. The target becomes hostile to the scapegoat until convinced of their innocence with a successful Presence Roll (17).

adversaries.name: Rust Eater
adversaries.description: A pony-sized cockroach coated in a corrosive chitin that turns metal into rust.

features.name: Stifling Pheromones
features.description: A PC who makes an action roll within Very Close range of the Rust Eater must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

features.name: Rust Touch
features.description: The Rust Eater's carapace is coated in a corrosive acid that pits and rusts metal. When a PC within Melee range of the Rust Easter succeeds on an attack against it with a metal weapon, reduce the weapon's damage die by one step (for example, d8 to d6 or d6 to d4). If a weapon's damage die is reduced below a d4, the weapon crumbles into rust. The Rust Eater then devours the rust pile and clears a HP.

adversaries.name: Scarecrow
adversaries.description: A bundle of straw bound into a humanoid shape, clothed in rags, and animated by a trapped soul.

features.name: Made of Straw
features.description: The Scarecrow has resistance to physical damage but takes double damage from fire.

features.name: Terror Vision
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Scarecrow lock eyes with a PC within Very Close range, dealing 2d8 magic damage and making them Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

adversaries.name: Secret-Keeper
adversaries.description: A clandestine leader with a direct channel to the Fallen Gods.

features.name: Seize Your Moment
features.description: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

features.name: Our Master's Will
features.description: When you spotlight an ally within Far range, mark a Stress to gain a Fear.

features.name: Summoning Ritual
features.description: When the Secret-Keeper is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When they mark HP, tick down this countdown by the number of HP marked. When it triggers, summon a Minor Demon who appears at Close range.

features.name: Fallen Hounds
features.description: Once per scene, when the Secret-Keeper marks 2 or more HP, you can mark a Stress to summon a Demonic Hound Pack, which appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

adversaries.name: Shark
adversaries.description: A large aquatic predator, always on the move.

features.name: Terrifying
features.description: When the Shark makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Rending Bite
features.description: When the Shark makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Blood in the Water
features.description: When a creature within Close range of the Shark marks HP from another creature's attack, you can mark a Stress to immediately spotlight the Shark, moving them into Melee range of the target and making a standard attack.

adversaries.name: Siren
adversaries.description: A half-fish person with shimmering scales and an irresistible voice.

features.name: Captive Audience
features.description: If the Siren makes a standard attack against a target Entranced by their song, the attack deals 2d10+1 damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Enchanting Song
features.description: Spend a Fear to sing a song that affects all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become Entranced until they mark 2 Stress. Other Sirens within Close range of the target can mark a Stress to each add a +1 bonus to the Difficulty of the reaction roll. While Entranced, a target can't act and is Vulnerable.

adversaries.name: Spectral Archer
adversaries.description: A ghostly fighter with an ethereal bow, unable to move on while their charge is vulnerable.

features.name: Ghost
features.description: The Archer has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Pick Your Target
features.description: Spend a Fear to make an attack within Far range against a PC who is within Very Close range of at least two other PCs. On a success, the target takes 2d8+12 physical damage.

adversaries.name: Spectral Captain
adversaries.description: A ghostly commander leading their troops beyond death.

features.name: Ghost
features.description: The Captain has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Unending Battle
features.description: Spend 2 Fear to return up to 1d4+1 defeated Spectral allies to the battle at the points where they first appeared (with no marked HP or Stress).

features.name: Hold Fast
features.description: When the Captain's Spectral allies are forced to make a reaction roll, you can mark a Stress to give those allies a +2 bonus to the roll.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Captain makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Spectral Guardian
adversaries.description: A ghostly fighter with spears and swords, anchored by duty.

features.name: Ghost
features.description: The Guardian has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Grave Blade
features.description: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+6 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Sprite
adversaries.description: A tiny winged warrior that attacks trespassers with poison-tipped arrows.
motives_tactics: let the poison do its work

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Sprite is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Sprite, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Art of Invisibility
features.description: Spend a Fear to make the Sprite Hidden until they attack.

features.name: Dream Petal Poison
features.description: When the Sprite succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Sleepy until the target takes damage. While Sleepy, the target must make a Presence Reaction Roll before they make an action roll. On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or fall asleep until they take damage.

adversaries.name: Spy
adversaries.description: A skilled espionage agent with a knack for being in the right place to overhear secrets.

features.name: Gathering Secrets
features.description: Spend a Fear to describe how the Spy knows a secret about a PC in the scene.

features.name: Fly on the Wall
features.description: When a PC or group is discussing something sensitive, you can mark a Stress to reveal that the Spy is present in the scene, observing them. If the Spy escapes the scene to report their findings, you gain 1d4 Fear.

adversaries.name: Stone Titan
adversaries.description: A gray-skinned goliath who lives underground and specializes in crafting powerjul items inlaid with magical runes.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Skillful Strike
features.description: Before the Titan makes an attack, you can mark a Stress and roll a d6. On a result of 3 or higher, the target's Evasion is halved against this attack.

features.name: Sunlight Sickness
features.description: When the Titan first appears above ground, roll a d4. Mark a number of Stress equal to the result. The Titan gains a bonus to their attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress marked.

features.name: Hammer Smash
features.description: When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

adversaries.name: Stonewraith
adversaries.description: A prowling hunter, like a slinking mountain lion, with a slate-gray stone body.

features.name: Stonestrider
features.description: The Stonewraith can move through stone and earth as easily as air. While within stone or earth, they are Hidden and immune to all damage.

features.name: Rocky Ambush
features.description: While Hidden, mark a Stress to leap into Melee range with a target within Very Close range. The target must succeed on an Agility or Instinct Reaction Roll (15) or take 2d8 physical damage and become temporarily Restrained.

features.name: Avalanche Roar
features.description: Spend a Fear to roar while within a cave and cause a cave-in. All targets within Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (14) or take 2d10 physical damage. The rubble can be cleared with a Progress Countdown (8).

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Stonewraith makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Triceratops
adversaries.description: A large dinosaur that has an armored frill and three horns.

features.name: Leathery Hide
features.description: When the Triceratops would be forced to mark HP, you can mark any number of Stress instead of an equal number of HP.

features.name: Tail Swipe
features.description: Mark a Stress to choose up to three targets within Very Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 5d6 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Bull Rush
features.description: Mark a Stress to choose a target within Close range. The Triceratops moves into Melee range with the target and makes an attack. On a success, deal 3d10 direct physical damage.

adversaries.name: Tyrannosaurus
adversaries.description: A huge carnivorous dinosaur that walks on two legs.

features.name: Earth-Shaking Roar
features.description: Spend a Fear to force each PC within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must choose to lose a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

features.name: Stomp
features.description: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 3d12 direct physical damage.

features.name: Crushing Bite
features.description: When the Tyrannosaurus makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an additional HP. : 129

adversaries.name: Urco
adversaries.description: A black-furred hound from beyond the veil of death that portends death and feeds on fear.

features.name: Fearmonger
features.description: When a PC within Very Close range fails with Hope, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Terror-Fueled
features.description: The Urco gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

features.name: Fear Eater
features.description: Spend any number of Fear to clear the same number of Stress. If the Urco has no marked Stress, you can spend any number of Fear to clear the same number of HP.

features.name: Baleful Gaze
features.description: When the Urco takes damage from an attack, you can spend a Fear to cause the attacker's damage thresholds to gain a -1 penalty until the end of the scene. This effect can stack.

adversaries.name: Valdenhax
adversaries.description: A malevolent forest hag who has long, mossy hair and flies through the air with an oversized mortar and pestle.

features.name: To Me, My Pretties
features.description: Once per scene, summon 2d4 Tier 2 Hordes, which appear at Far range. You gain a Fear for each Horde summoned in this way.

features.name: Shadow Strangler
features.description: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, the shadow of the Valdenhax's hand stretches across the ground until it grasps the target's shadow and drains their essence. The target marks 1d4 Stress, and you gain an equal number of Fear.

features.name: Corpse Whisperer
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Valdenhax call out to the lingering spirit of a fallen ally within Close range. Roll a d6. On an even result, the Valdenhax resurrects the ally with half its HP cleared. On an odd result, the Valdenhax absorbs the dregs of its life force and clears a Stress.

features.name: Vexing Word
features.description: After a PC makes a roll, you can mark a Stress to force them to reroll it. This feature can't be used if the PC critically succeeds.

adversaries.name: War Wizard
adversaries.description: A battle-hardened mage trained in destructive magic.

features.name: Battle Teleport
features.description: Before or after making a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to teleport to a location within Far range.

features.name: Refresh Warding Sphere
features.description: Mark a Stress to refresh the Wizard's 'Warding Sphere' reaction.

features.name: Eruption
features.description: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. A Very Close area around that point erupts into impassable terrain. All targets within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (14). Targets who fail take 2d10 physical damage and are thrown out of the area. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren't moved.

features.name: Arcane Artillery
features.description: Spend a Fear to unleash a precise hail of magical blasts. All targets in the scene must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d12 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Warding Sphere
features.description: When the Wizard takes damage from an attack within Close range, deal 2d6 magic damage to the attacker. This reaction can't be used again until the Wizard refreshes it with their 'Refresh Warding Sphere' action.
